features.quote: The agent runs for a maximum of 40 iterations (tool calls) or until the context window reaches 90% capacity (whichever comes first).
Implement a hardcoded circuit breaker in your orchestration script that terminates the session if the agent repeats the exact same tool call arguments 5 times consecutively.
features.justification_quote: A model stuck in a 40-step loop with a large context window will consume significant API credits.

features.quote: The protocol must treat the LLM Judge's ratings as measures of *textual deviation from rational problem-solving*, not as a diagnostic of a psychological state. Conflating the two invalidates the empirical validity of the research.
